about: What the compiled web-fetch adapters (fetch_web.rs on main@e7a9e965) sent and what an agent read, for each captured case. A case's top-level fields are the compiled behaviour; `now` overrides the fields this issue changes on purpose, and `change` says why. The pack declarations must reproduce every case with its `now` applied.

requests.change: The declaration language has no conditionals, so gotoOptions is always sent. The compiled default sent nothing, which Cloudflare documents as domcontentloaded; a stored `load` is no longer a choice and falls back to that default, so the page-load semantics are unchanged and only the request bytes differ.
Jina percent-decodes its path once, so a raw target holding escapes or a fragment reached the origin altered. The target is now sent |query-encoded, which Jina returns exactly.

responses.err: Firecrawl returned an unexpected response for `https://example.com/a?b=c`: expected ident at line 1 column 2

now.err: Firecrawl fetch of `https://example.com/a?b=c` failed: Unsupported URL

responses.change: The success gate: Firecrawl's success:false is now a failed fetch carrying its error, not a missing-markdown error.

responses.err: Firecrawl fetch of `https://example.com/a?b=c` failed: HTTP 402 — {"success":false,"error":"Payment required"}

now.err: Firecrawl fetch of `https://example.com/a?b=c` failed: HTTP 402 — Payment required.

responses.change: One fetch failure text for every provider (Cloudflare's): the gate's error path names the detail, and the sentence ends with a period.
The shared failure text drops the dash when there is no detail.

firecrawl_no_key.before: No API key set for Firecrawl web fetch. Add it in Settings → Web Services.
firecrawl_no_key.now: No API key set for Firecrawl web fetch. Add it in the Library.

cloudflare_not_authorized.before: Cloudflare web fetch is not authorized. Connect it in Settings → Web Services.
cloudflare_not_authorized.now: Cloudflare Browser Run web fetch is not authorized. Connect it in the Library.

cloudflare_no_account.before: The Cloudflare Browser Run web-fetch provider is missing its account ID. Set your Cloudflare account ID in Settings → Web Services.
cloudflare_no_account.now: Cloudflare Browser Run web fetch needs its Cloudflare account. Set it in the Library.

cloudflare_choose_account.before: Cloudflare Browser Run web fetch needs its Account ID. Set it in the Library.
cloudflare_choose_account.now: Cloudflare Browser Run web fetch needs its Cloudflare account, and the connected login reaches 2: Acme, Personal. Choose one in the Library.

cloudflare_no_reachable_account.before: Cloudflare Browser Run web fetch needs its Account ID. Set it in the Library.
cloudflare_no_reachable_account.now: The connected Cloudflare Browser Run login reaches no Cloudflare account. Connect a login that does in the Library.

bmd_not_connected.before: The bmd web-fetch provider is not configured. Add and connect the bmd MCP server in Settings → Web Services, or switch providers.
bmd_not_connected.now: bmd web fetch needs its MCP server `bmd` connected. Connect it in the Library.
